Earphones work best. Kinly only talks about money and cannot change your entries.
Before you talk to Kinly
To talk, your voice is sent live to Google\'s Gemini, which answers back in voice.
When you ask about your money, only totals are shared, like \"spent this month\". Never names, notes, phone numbers or account numbers.
Kinly does not save what you say or hear.
This uses Google\'s free service, so Google may use these conversations to improve its products.
Never say passwords, OTPs or card numbers.
